name: REELINGTHELOVEIN
source:
A game where you work aboard a ship alongside a captain who’s eager to get closer to you… only to discover that someone else is also trying to get close—but for reasons very different from what you expect. 

[From [url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/reelingthelovein]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一款游戏中，你和一位船长一起在一艘船上工作，船长渴望接近你……却发现其他人也在试图接近你——但原因与你的预期截然不同。

[来自[url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/reelingthelovein]Itch.io[/url]]
